scope: Image-Edit, original frozen parser/editor for primary model comparisons

allowed: existing tests for historical reporting only
forbidden: sealed test inference before model lock

baseline_rule: All four original self-trained adapters frozen. Compare candidate to each on final test; identify strongest original baseline on that test for conservative goal assessment. Never select or revise candidate from these comparisons.
candidate_lock: checkpoint-selection rule based on full validation

primary_endpoint.definition: (mean baseline L1 - mean candidate L1) / mean baseline L1, paired on identical independent original-image groups; all samples retained with original fallback on invalid output
primary_endpoint.replication: At least 3 independent training seeds, each satisfying the point target against strongest frozen original baseline
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: 10000 paired source-group bootstrap draws; report each seed interval and seed-level range. Seed-averaged intervals resample source groups without pretending seed-by-image rows are independent. Report simultaneous-comparison limitations; no subgroup replaces primary endpoint.

guardrails.execution: Report validity and executable rate per seed; must maintain strongest original baseline executable rate, failures never removed.
guardrails.nonoperation: Report exact pixel identity, empty/zero parameters, output-vs-input L1 distribution, and near-identity fraction at 1/255. More fallback or no-op is not accepted as a quality gain. Repeat improvement calculations on the predeclared union of samples with substantive edits in baseline or candidate as a diagnostic, without replacing all-row endpoint.
guardrails.instruction: Explicit direction checks use only instruction and input/output pixels: brightness via luminance, warmth via R-B, saturation via HSV S. Negated/conflicting/localized/ambiguous requests are marked not assessable by global proxy, not counted as passes. Separate partial/incorrect/excessive changes. Compare per-seed rates to baseline and inspect broader instructions in anonymized visual panels.
guardrails.visual_review: 30 seeded source groups fixed before predictions, include input/reference and all compared outputs; record observations before decoding model order. AI-assisted review explicitly disclosed; no claim of human preference equivalence.
guardrails.NoEdit: Report NoEdit L1 alongside all models. Alpha=0 calibration is a diagnostic baseline, not an acceptable trained-model result.

notes: 71 independent new groups may yield wide intervals; do not redefine an inconclusive result as success.
Any future editor revision requires a separate identity and matched baseline ablation; do not alter original historical outputs.
Initial single-seed pilots are development only; they cannot satisfy the multi-seed goal.
